exclusiveCommands.symptom: These write to the database DATABASE_URL names — the developer's own `travel`, which is shared. The test lanes no longer do (each run gets its own database, KI-2026-08-30-e), but a reset or a reseed still lands on whatever another worktree is looking at.

A dev server started by hand binds WEB_PORT, which defaults to 3001 in every worktree. Set WEB_PORT to run a second one. `test:e2e` is deliberately NOT in this pattern: it picks a free port itself (with-test-db.mjs --with-port).
